message: Don't build another AI app — build the tool that replaces one spreadsheet a business owner already hates

lines.text: Nobody pays for another AI app, but every business owner you know will pay to never open a spreadsheet again.
Ask one owner which spreadsheet they still fill in by hand.
Open Claude Code and describe it in plain English.
Add a login and Stripe, and you can charge for it tonight.
Sell it to that owner, then their whole industry. Comment TOOL for the prompt.
